notes.text: Leonardo Bonacci, commonly known as Fibonacci, was an Italian mathematician from the Republic of Pisa, considered to be "the most talented Western mathematician of the Middle Ages".
Fibonacci is remembered as a mathematician connected with Italy.
Fibonacci's recorded life dates place this profile around 1170-1240.
Fibonacci is grouped with Science, Math & Technology in the People Library.
Fibonacci's profile connects a short Fact to a wider Italy historical setting.
